author: Alice Chen
description: PNG/JPEG decoding and pixel manipulation. Pure Nova implementation.

examples.title: Decode a PNG file
examples.code:
import img

image = img.decode("photo.png")
print(image.width)   # 1920
print(image.height)  # 1080
print(image.pixel(0, 0))  # RGB value

examples.title: Resize image
examples.code:
import img

image = img.decode("photo.png")
small = img.resize(image, 320, 200)
img.encode(small, "thumbnail.png")
